method: SALib optimized Morris trajectories (Ruano local optimization).
replication_rationale: Five fixed common seeds at every point match the revised intervention/horizon experiments. Twelve trajectories selected for input-space coverage within a finite computational budget; neither count is a prospective power calculation. Report seed dispersion and leave-one-seed-out rank stability; do not assert convergence.
input_scope: Jointly vary ten continuous input controls. Demand remains a stress variable. No separate weather factor: speed/acceleration/deceleration/sigma are its constituent controls. Discrete lane restrictions, bottleneck edge-speed changes, offset redesign and geometry are outside this screen.
vehicle_scope: Keep original car and parameterized heavy-vehicle archetypes and OD split logic. No vClass or emissionClass is newly introduced; no emission result is used. Truck acceleration/deceleration/minGap stay 1.2/3.5/3; sigma=max(input,0.55), tau=max(input,1). Car behavior parameters vary independently. Results are conditional on these type definitions.
rounding: Flow totals and truck counts round to nearest integer per OD using Python round; report realized total/share. Green/yellow duration is rounded to 0.1 s; offsets and all phase state strings stay fixed. Any phase containing y/Y receives only the yellow factor even if other movements remain green. Other phases containing G receive only the green factor. This disjoint definition and timing grid are new, not a re-run of the legacy OAT which could green-scale mixed clearance phases as well.
settings: SUMO 1.24.0; Krauss; ballistic; simulation/action 0.1/0.1 s; 0-3600 s; no discarded warm-up; demand only over 0-3600 s; junction checks true; collision teleport; gridlock teleport 300 s; insertion checks all. Same route departure settings as original (free/max).
output_reduction: Remove passive local detectors, FCD and lane-change files to reduce output I/O. Keep every 0.1-s summary step, all-population tripinfo, statistics, collision details and warnings. Before design runs, five baseline controls must reproduce archived 0.1/0.1-s counts, vehicle-hours and completed-trip statistics.
estimator: SALib unscaled Morris mu, mu_star and sigma on the five-seed mean at each point; unit-cube elementary step 2/3. Units are response units per full specified input range, not per physical unit. Calculate each seed separately and leave-one-seed-out estimates. No composite score is needed.
uncertainty: Primary descriptive screen: paired seed contrasts before averaging, not individual vehicles as replicates. SALib bootstrap mu_star interval (2000 resamples, seed 20261021, 95%) reflects trajectory uncertainty conditional on seed means only. Separately report five per-seed indices and leave-one-seed-out ranks; do not present SALib intervals as total stochastic uncertainty. Preserve broad/overlapping intervals and range dependence.
warnings: Retain all finite completed runs in raw simulator-response sensitivity, including warning-contaminated states; warnings are explicit additional responses. No warning-based trajectory deletion from primary analysis, no claim of physical service sensitivity for contaminated points. A descriptive warning-free pair audit may be reported with denominators, never as an unbiased full-domain Morris estimator.
failure: Any process failure, incomplete horizon or broken accounting pauses analysis. Preserve failed directory and amend transparently; no zero imputation or replacement seed/trajectory. Do not calculate full-design indices from incomplete trajectories.
freeze: Design, input bounds, common seed list, runner and metric code frozen before design outcomes. No outcome-driven selection or adaptation. Runs may be executed in deterministic bounded batches.
manuscript_placement: Existing robustness/statistics subsection and supporting appendix; no major section/innovation restructuring. No compile during evidence phase.
